_comment: Seed domain pool for the Eureka Engine (hypothesis_engine.py), which now has two independent generation modes: bisociation (two domains) and janusian (one domain, its assumption inverted). already_paired lists domain pairs already explored via bisociation, including full case studies pre-dating this engine in the-rosetta-stone/case-studies/ — excluded by default so autonomous mode reaches for genuinely novel bisociations. already_janused lists domains already explored via Janusian mode, tracked independently -- a domain can appear in both lists without conflict, since inverting a domain's own assumption and pairing it against another domain are different operations. domain_pool is deliberately broad across physical, informational, biological, social, and creative domains so a random or deliberate pick has real room to be distant, not adjacent. 2026-08-31: pool exhausted for Janusian mode (0 remaining un-janused of 59) mid-cycle -- added 50 new, hand-reviewed domains (proposal-005, Option 1) covering fields the original pool didn't touch (physics, CS/math, genetics, psychology, humanities, arts, engineering, natural sciences), matching the existing style and the pool's own breadth principle. See refutations/ (or Ops/Event Log.md) for the real trigger.

usage_notes.pairing_rule: Prefer pairs that cross at least two of: Physical, Informational, Human/Social, Creative (per the UMPF domain classification in scientific-intuition-engine/readme.md). A pair drawn from the same category (e.g. two pure-CS domains) is allowed but should be flagged as lower-novelty in the output's self-critique.
usage_notes.exclusion_rule: Never select a pair that matches (in either order) an entry in already_paired — that combination is already a written case study in the-rosetta-stone/case-studies/.
usage_notes.extension: Append newly-explored pairs to already_paired after each successful hypothesis run, so the pool never repeats itself across sessions.
usage_notes.combined_pool_note: hypothesis_engine.py's pick_fresh_pair/pick_fresh_domain draw from the UNION of this file's domain_pool and rosetta_stone_domains.json's 23-system pool (see hypothesis_engine.py's load_combined_pool()) -- added 2026-08-28. already_paired/already_janused/already_homospatial entries can reference domains from either source pool; the tracking lists don't distinguish provenance, since pair/domain identity is what matters for exclusion, not which file a domain string originated in.
